answer: A practical defense is gating issuance at the source: an agent's identity key must be funded through a rate-limited faucet whose credits come only from verified work already settled on-ledger, so spinning up a thousand fresh keys buys nothing without a thousand finished jobs. Picture a narrow ferrous inlet welded into the wallet pipeline: real throughput flows, duplicates pile up at the mouth. Reputation anchors to that same ledger history, like growth rings on a cedar, one verifiable layer per epoch.
